survey: A black cat figurine sits on a wooden plank tabletop in front of a wall with vertical orange stripes. The camera is a little above the cat and to its front-left, in a three-quarter view. The planks run diagonally away toward the upper right, and their spacing and angles match a floor seen from slightly above. The back edge of the table meets the wall at a shallow angle. The wall stripes are straight verticals, which is right for a wall facing the camera. The cat's body sits upright on the planks. Its front paws and haunch rest flat on the boards, and its tail curls forward along the floor with a soft shadow falling right-back. The head is turned slightly to the viewer's left. The far eye (viewer's left) is narrower than the near eye, and the nose sits closer to the far eye, so the face foreshortens correctly. The red collar is a ring seen slightly from above: its front edge curves gently downward and it wraps behind the neck on both sides. The ears are cones that point up and away, matching the head's turn. The floor, body, collar ring and head all read as seen from one camera, and the ground contact is believable.
